Subject: Discovery recap — demo baton (US/EU/APAC) & next steps

Hi Jace —

Great call earlier, thanks for walking us through Medivue's ingestion roadmap and the retention constraints for clinical audit logs. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

Recap (short):
- Primary use case: near-real-time inference for triage workflows (batch sizes ~50–200 requests/min).
- Data constraints: 30-day hot cache, 1-year cold retention; SOC 2 required.
- Success metric: steady-state 99th percentile latency < 120ms for gen routes; cost-sensitive on tokens for high-volume endpoints.

Next steps I propose — demo baton plan (to share load across time zones):
1) Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with your infra and product leads.
2) To make scheduling equitable across US/EU/APAC, we suggest a rotating weekly window we call the "demo baton": one week the call sits in a US-friendly window, week two in EU-friendly hours, week three in APAC-friendly hours. This reduces late-night meetings for your teams and gives us consistent coverage.
3) I attached a short agenda and a requirements spreadsheet so your engineering team can pre-populate any sample scenarios.

Proposed slots for next week (all 60m):
- Option A: Tue Jul 22, 15:00–16:00 UTC (US late-morning / EU afternoon)
- Option B: Wed Jul 23, 08:00–09:00 UTC (APAC early evening / US early morning)
- Option C: Thu Jul 24, 18:00–19:00 UTC (EU late afternoon / APAC morning)

Can you confirm which option works, or drop your preferred slots and I'll coordinate? If helpful, here is a single-calendar link for pick: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-baton-30m (I can adjust for 60m).

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
